test_results.observation: The real worker transaction probe kept ObjectStore, extraction and provider work outside finalization transactions. The HTTP contract now serializes the existing PDF page and half-open offset locators unchanged. A deterministic final commit-boundary guard fences an expired lease and rolls back every tentative derivation, activation, attempt, transition and terminal-job mutation.

The rerun preserved historical active-and-served PDF retrieval when a newer current version failed; immutable profile selection remained pinned to the claimed work and did not fall back to mutable current selection.

Carried forward from acceptance-02: the controlled handler failure matrix and retry-policy observation remain valid because neither remediation changes handler taxonomy, provider/object-store boundaries, nor vector validation.
The rerun showed that B remains current, active and served; stale A is atomically superseded and cannot overwrite B. The final fencing guard applies to this terminal path as well.

The rerun confirmed independent duplicate delivery avoids duplicate handler/provider work, same TransitionOperationId reconciliation replays its durable result without duplicate rows, and a definite pre-commit rollback leaves no PDF or lifecycle mutation.
TC-06A/C remain valid from acceptance-01. TC-06B was rerun because finalization changed: a late expired lease returns Fenced and commits zero tentative mutation.
Carried forward from acceptance-02: the remediations do not change ObjectStore metadata validation, streaming ownership, extraction or provider execution.
Carried forward from acceptance-01/02: neither remediation changes database ownership, completeness, active-set or current-version constraints.
The rerun retained the Original Source Object on both concrete terminal success and deterministic terminal failure; the delete spy recorded no ObjectStore deletion.

approval_blocker: All locked technical oracles passed, but manual-acceptance policy requires explicit human approval before this run may be recorded as PASSED.
